action.command:
for h in api.urbo.localhost keycloak.urbo.localhost cms.urbo.localhost app.urbo.localhost meilisearch.urbo.localhost; do
 code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --resolve "$h:80:127.0.0.1" "http://$h/" 2>&1)
 echo "$h -> $code"
done
